name: When Destiny Brings the Demon
description: Modern-day office drone Zou Yan accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation and wakes up as Liao Tingyan, a disciple of the Qinggutian Sect. She's soon selected to serve the reclusive Grandmaster Sima Jiao, a powerful cultivator who's been secretly sealed inside a mountain for 500 years. Twisted by isolation and rage, he's cold, hot-tempered, and bent on revenge. Liao Tingyan doesn't know that "her" original identity is a demonic assassin. But to his surprise, she shows no ill will, no ambition, and no desire at all. Her nature fascinates him. Thus begins an unlikely romance between a villainous immortal and a healing-type "slacker," a connection that defies fate and spans lifetimes.

credits_cast.character: Liao Tingyan / Shi Yan / Zou Yan
credits_cast.name: Wang Yinglu

videos.title: An Unbothered Player in the Survival Game
videos.overview: Immortal Sima Jiao forms a bond with his mysterious new assistant Liao Tingyan. As they grow closer, he tries to find out more about her.

videos.title: Struck by an NPC's Fate, but Can't Go AFK
videos.overview: Sima Jiao allows Liao Tingyan to stay with him after learning her true identity, but her strange responses while under a spell add to the intrigue.

videos.title: Don't Try to Understand Madness. Lay Low and Live Another Day
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan finds an ally and questions her relationship with Sima Jiao. Meanwhile, Sima Jiao tries to break his seal but suffers harmful consequences.

videos.title: The True Meaning Behind "Kill Me" is Way Too Scary
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan grows closer to Sima Jiao after learning of his imprisonment. An Xue plots against Liao Tingyan after overhearing a piece of information.

videos.title: The Key Player and Survivorin the Grandmaster's Revenge Plan
videos.overview: After Sima Jiao injures himself, the mountain comes under attack. Liao Tingyan falls into trouble and Ye Ruling's identity is revealed.

videos.title: I Got Wind of Grandmaster's Most Guarded Secret. What to Do Now?
videos.overview: The palaces arrange a marriage between Sima E and Sima Shi. Liao Tingyan decides to stay with Sima Jiao, who doesn't realize he is falling for her.

videos.title: He'd Only Ever Killed. The Few He Saved Were for Her
videos.overview: Sima Jiao brings Liao Tingyan to a banquet, which descends into conflict. Shi Qianlu tries to reseal Sima Jiao and misses an important appointment.

videos.title: It Turns Out That I'm a Player Who Cannot Remain Uninvolved
videos.overview: Hei Nianjiu pledges allegiance to Ye Ruling, while Master Zhenxu plots to frame Sima Jiao. As alliances shift, Liao Tingyan becomes bait in a trap.

videos.title: Glitched into an In-Game Odyssey of Cultivation Trials and Tribulations
videos.overview: Ye Ruling tries to warn Liao Tingyan, but Sima Jiao steps in. Shi Qianlu sends Shi Zhenxu to Chiyan City — Sima Jiao's next destination.

videos.title: A Disguised Inspection with Grandmaster is Always a Disaster
videos.overview: After his bloodline awakens, Sima Jiao changes form to learn about his birthmark. Meanwhile, Ye Ruling meets Liao Tingyan at the Yan residence.

videos.title: Feels Like a Love-Struck Girl
videos.overview: A disguised Sima Jiao stirs trouble in the Yan home while Liao Tingyan pushes him to reveal his feelings. Master Yan reveals his ancient ties.

videos.title: The Real Battle is Inside the Mean Grandmaster's Home
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan comforts Sima Jiao when a tragedy triggers memories of his past. Shi Qianlu attempts to frame Sima Jiao.

videos.title: She is the Last Breath of Hope for the Grandmaster?
videos.overview: Sima Jiao and Liao Tingyan escape captivity into a spiritual realm. Shi Qianlu spreads lies, fueling Shi Zhenxu's hatred toward Sima Jiao.

videos.title: A Role-Play Game Amidst Peril
videos.overview: Ye Ruling allies with Shi Qianlu. Liao Tingyan and Sima Jiao take an important step to evade hunters and put their plan in motion.

videos.title: Love Takes Two to Tango
videos.overview: Sima Jiao gives Liao Tinyang a gift to help them communicate when they're apart from each other. Shi Qianlu's people try to catch Hei Nianjiu.

videos.title: Long-Distance Relationships are Bound to Have Many Uncertainties
videos.overview: When Liao Tingyan faces danger, Ye Ruling reports the incident to Shi Qianlu. Sima Jiao rushes to the rescue and forms a plan to confuse their enemies.

videos.title: The Man Who Fights Lightning with His Bare Hands is the Ultimate Catch
videos.overview: Sima Jiao helps Liao Tingyan recover, and their deepening relationship produces a surprising outcome. However, danger awaits in Fenghua City.

videos.title: No Quest is Harder Than Love
videos.overview: Shi Qianlu tries to trap Sima Jiao but the plan backfires with deadly consequences. Sima Jiao pushes Liao Tingyan past her limits, leaving her in shock.

videos.title: Immortals and Demons are Worlds Apart, Separated by Life and Death
videos.overview: Sima Jiao learns the truth about his family at Taiwei Mountain. Shi Qianlu tries to use Liao Tingyan as bait, but she vanishes as the plan unfolds.

videos.title: Given the Average Lifespan in This World, It's Only a Brief Parting
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan seeks a peaceful life after Shi Qianlu erases her memory and gives her a new identity. Sima Jiao desperately searches for her.

videos.title: Shi Qianlv, the Stock You Bought Tanked
videos.overview: In Hexian City, Shi Yan learns that Sima Jiao is the attacker. Shi Qianlu urges her to seek revenge, but Hei Nianjiu has other plans.

videos.title: What's Your Lover Liao Tingyan Got to Do with Me, Shi Yan?
videos.overview: Sima Jiao tries to bond with Shi Yan, but her doubts about her true identity hold her back. Hei Nianjiu's search for Shi Qianlu unearths a surprise.

videos.title: If We Still Have Faith in Love, Memory Loss Just Here to Spice Things Up
videos.overview: Hei Nianjiu shares what he's learned. A jealous Sima Jiao revisits the past with Shi Yan to soften her heart and revive her memory.

videos.title: Was It Really Me? The Girl Who Valiantly Dated Big Boss Back Then?
videos.overview: Seeking the truth about her identity, Shi Yan tries to escape. Sima Jiao helps her, with unexpected results. A plot to kill Sima Jiao begins to brew.

videos.title: Traveling Together on Vacation is the Perfect Chance to Grow Closer
videos.overview: Sima Jiao and Liao Tingyan reunite and grow closer than ever. Believing Sima Jiao has wronged him, Feng Qi conspires to get revenge.

videos.title: This is Some Dangerous Romance
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan feels a chill when she kisses Sima Jiao, alerting them to danger. Shi Qianlu tricks Liao Tingyan into removing her bracelet.

videos.title: Now I Am Strong Enough to Fight Lightning Too
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan helps Sima Jiao and Hei Nianjiu escape before falling into an abyss. Recovering her memories and powers, she claims a new identity.

videos.title: Will It Only Be Happiness From Here On?
videos.overview: Feng Qi offers to help Liao Tingyan. However, when renewed conflict breaks out, he reveals his ulterior motives and puts a sinister plan into action.

videos.title: If the Harsh Winter Comes, He'll Leave Me a Fire
videos.overview: Sima Jiao's loss leaves a devastated and heartbroken Liao Tingyan behind. Nineteen years later, he is reborn with no memory of his past.

videos.title: The Villain in the Story May Be Late, but Will Surely Arrive
videos.overview: Sima Jiao grows close to Liao Tingyan but doubts her motives. When she reacts strangely to an injury during an assassination attempt, the mystery grows.

videos.title: The More We Keep Secrets, the More We Look Like a Couple
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan reveals the truth about their bond to a skeptical Sima Jiao. Together with Hong Luo, she tries to learn more about a dangerous plot.

videos.title: It is for You. You Can Do Whatever You Like to It
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan discovers how to suppress her demon side and asks Sima Jiao to help. Later, she must contend with false imprisonment and a severe drought.

videos.title: I Saved You, and I Will Find You Again
videos.overview: Liao Tingyan and Sima Jiao plan a wedding to lure their enemies. When things take a surprising turn, Liao Tingyan questions where she truly belongs.
